decision_scope: Authoritative product, public access and complete listed calendar locked; research payloads not acquired or analysis-ready.

locked_source.title: Global gapless 1 km daily mean land surface temperature dataset (2003-2023)
locked_source.host: National Tibetan Plateau / Third Pole Environment Data Center (TPDC)
locked_source.paper_citation: Xiang, J., Quan, J. & Zhan, W. (2026). Global gapless 1 km daily mean land surface temperature (70 degrees N-60 degrees S, 2003-2023) via integrated approaches. Scientific Data.
locked_source.citation_requirement: Attribute Xiang and Quan, dataset title, TPDC and dataset DOI; cite the three-author descriptor separately.

locked_response.definition: UCDB urban-footprint mean daily-mean LST, 2018-2023 climatology; no rural-reference subtraction
locked_response.S: Provisional S3 at 2020 (overlaps R window; not universally strict-precedence)

access.verified_primary_method: Anonymous public per-file HTTP POST, JSON {noToken:true}
access.temporal_subsetting: Select year and daily file IDs before transfer
access.spatial_subsetting: No documented or verified server-side spatial cutout; assume full daily raster transfer
access.http_range_status: Range ignored in observed probe; interrupted transfers must restart the file unless a future endpoint is verified
access.ftp: Guest credential endpoint responds; both advertised FTP hosts reset login. Not relied on for source lock.

format.conversion: Mask raw zero before applying T_degC = raw_int16 * 0.01 - 273.15
format.embedded_scale_or_unit: Not provided in inspected TIFF header / prior sample metadata; use documentation explicitly
format.verification_extent: One complete-source header, three prior sample headers; every downloaded file still needs grid/schema validation

requires_GEE_generation: Daily uint16 MODIS errors/count and Step-1 temporal-upscaling QA
QA.not_verified_available: Full final Step-3 optimization uncertainty or exact final pixel-day fill-provenance mask
QA.city_domain_error_calibration: Not established by the reported overall or independent station RMSE

hardware_feasibility.note: Storage/throughput arithmetic only; not a benchmark or a RAM guarantee.
hardware_feasibility.recommended_storage: Raw on D; one-year batches; optional month cache on C; yearly city intermediates
hardware_feasibility.recommended_processing: Sparse tile-to-city membership mapping, deterministic tile order, bounded block reads and sums/counts; compare with zonal_mean reference

items: Daily/period meaning of >=9 valid pixels, temporal support/exclusion and QA sensitivity rules, and equal-calendar-day weighting before response modeling
Common-population and boundary/period harmonization needed before attributing SUHI-vs-LST differences to rural-reference mixing
Strict-precedence S sensitivity and boundary-vintage leakage audit
Prespecified negative-control outcome and response-reconstruction sensitivity

next_action: Stop after 1006-3. Recommend a future authorized human acquisition of a fixed one-month engineering pilot, then hash/calendar/grid validation and bounded-memory benchmarking before scaling to six years.
